purpose: Post-reveal descriptive replay of the cap-20 shadow candidate on the exact frozen 24-case 2025-2026 House holdout. The cap was selected mechanically by the pre-frozen #178 full-history rule; this replay cannot promote it to production.

replayPolicy.quickAnaloguePipeline: unchanged historical Quick analogue selection and weighting
replayPolicy.caseSelection: exact frozen 24 holdout cases; no replacement or reranking
replayPolicy.baseline: immutable uncapped Quick probabilities and outcomes from the one-shot #176 holdout artifact

reportedMetrics: case-level signed residual and expected-Yes error

interpretation.primaryQuestion: Does the mechanically selected cap-20 shadow candidate improve the exact already-revealed holdout relative to the immutable uncapped baseline?
interpretation.notConfirmatory: The 2025-2026 outcomes were revealed before cap selection/replay. Any improvement is retrospective descriptive evidence only.
interpretation.promotionBoundary: No outcome of this replay may change MEMBER_MODEL_VERSION, maximumMemberHistoryWeight runtime defaults, production probabilities, Deep targeting, or Journal mechanics. A cap may advance only to a separately frozen prospective/shadow validation.
